BillHeading.Sponsors: House Labor (originally sponsored by Representatives Reykdal, Hayes, Sawyer, Van De Wege, Holy, Griffey, Riccelli, Fitzgibbon, Ormsby, and Pollet)
BillHeading.BriefDescription: Creating a work group on occupational disease exposure for firefighters.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to an occupational disease exposure reporting requirement for firefighters; creating a new section; and providing an expiration date.

BillSectionHeader.P: (1) Beginning August 1, 2015, the department of labor and industries shall convene a work group to discuss establishing definitions, policies, and procedures for mandatory reporting of hazardous exposures suffered in the course of employment by firefighters.

BillSection.P: (2) The work group must include, at a minimum, stakeholders representing firefighter unions, fire departments, fire chiefs, state fund public employers, and self-insured employers.
(3) By January 1, 2016, the department must report to the appropriate committees of the legislature any recommendations for legislation or rule making.
